message: Replaced the official `caddy` image in the split-services Compose stacks with this fork's own Caddy build, compiled from source against a pinned Go 1.26.7 toolchain. The upstream image still ships a Go 1.26.5 standard library, flagged for CVE-2026-39821, CVE-2026-56865, CVE-2026-56864, CVE-2026-56862, CVE-2026-56859, CVE-2026-56853, CVE-2026-46600 and CVE-2026-33818.
